sources.title: Ensemble Bert4rec for Recsys 2025 Challenge
sources.snippet: Our solution highlights how transformer-based self-supervised learning can effectively model complex, multi-modal user behavior sequences. By training separate BERT4Rec instances for each interaction type and fusing embeddings, we achieved strong generalization across both known and hidden tasks in the RecSys Challenge 2025.
